label: New document
hover_description: New document: Start an empty CAD document. Save any work you want to keep first.

label: Open document
hover_description: Open document: Choose a CAD document to validate and load.

label: Save document
hover_description: Save document: Save the CAD parameters and feature history to a file.

label: Undo
hover_description: Undo: Reverse the last editing action in this session.

label: Redo
hover_description: Redo: Restore the last action undone in this session.

label: Rebuild model
hover_description: Rebuild model: Recalculate the CAD result from its saved parameters and feature history.

label: Feature history
hover_description: Feature history: Show the operations that define this CAD model.

label: Frame CAD result
hover_description: Frame CAD result: Isolate and fit the CAD result in the viewport.

label: Show whole scene
hover_description: Show whole scene: Leave the isolated CAD view and frame all scene objects.

label: Check model
hover_description: Check model: Run the available geometry checks and show their results.

label: Export CAD result
hover_description: Export CAD result: Choose a file format and export the current checked result.

label: Apply
hover_description: Apply: Commit the values in this operation and update the model.

label: Cancel
hover_description: Cancel: Close this operation without applying its changes.

label: Help
hover_description: Help: Show instructions, required inputs, and current limitations for this tool.

label: CAD settings
hover_description: CAD settings: Review the setup used by the Mechanical CAD add-on.

label: Warning
hover_description: Warning: Read the accompanying explanation before continuing.
usage: Status only; always accompany with specific visible text.

label: Failed
hover_description: Failed: The operation did not complete. Read the error and check its inputs.
usage: Status only; always accompany with specific visible text.

label: Passed
hover_description: Passed: The displayed check completed successfully. Read the check details for its scope.
usage: Status only; must identify which check actually passed.

label: Rectangle sketch
hover_description: Rectangle sketch: Create a closed XY profile from its width, height, and lower-left corner, in millimetres.

label: Circle sketch
hover_description: Circle sketch: Create a closed XY profile from its center and a positive radius, in millimetres.

label: Sketch line
hover_description: Sketch line: Draw a line between two endpoints on the active sketch plane.

label: Sketch dimension
hover_description: Sketch dimension: Set a distance between the selected sketch points or edges.

label: Coincident constraint
hover_description: Coincident constraint: Make two selected sketch points occupy the same position.

label: Horizontal constraint
hover_description: Horizontal constraint: Keep the selected sketch line horizontal in its sketch plane.

label: Vertical constraint
hover_description: Vertical constraint: Keep the selected sketch line vertical in its sketch plane.

label: Parallel constraint
hover_description: Parallel constraint: Keep two selected sketch lines parallel.

label: Perpendicular constraint
hover_description: Perpendicular constraint: Keep two selected sketch lines at a right angle.

label: Equal constraint
hover_description: Equal constraint: Give the selected compatible sketch entities equal lengths or radii.

label: Tangent constraint
hover_description: Tangent constraint: Make the selected supported sketch entities touch with a common direction.

label: Fix sketch point
hover_description: Fix sketch point: Hold the selected point at its current sketch coordinates.

label: Extrude profile
hover_description: Extrude profile: Select a saved closed sketch and create a solid along +Z using a positive length, in millimetres.

label: Cut solid
hover_description: Cut solid: Choose target and tool solids. Subtract the tool from the target; operand order matters.

label: New component
hover_description: New component: Define a reusable part for the assembly.

label: Place component
hover_description: Place component: Add another placement of a reusable part to the assembly.

label: Fixed mate
hover_description: Fixed mate: Lock the relative position and orientation of the selected components.

label: Revolute mate
hover_description: Revolute mate: Align two selected axes and allow rotation around their shared axis.

label: Slider mate
hover_description: Slider mate: Align selected components and allow translation along one shared axis.

label: Check interference
hover_description: Check interference: Find overlapping solid volumes in the selected components.

label: Measure clearance
hover_description: Measure clearance: Measure the shortest gap between the selected supported faces or components.

label: New drilled-plate demo
hover_description: New drilled-plate demo: Replace the current CAD document with the editable example. Save work you want to keep first.

label: Previous feature
hover_description: Previous feature: Move to the preceding operation in the CAD feature history.

label: Next feature
hover_description: Next feature: Move to the next operation in the CAD feature history.

label: Export STEP
hover_description: Export STEP: Write the checked CAD result as exact solid geometry in a STEP file.
usage: Use a visible STEP caption; a shape alone cannot reliably communicate a file format.

label: Export STL
hover_description: Export STL: Write a triangulated copy of the checked CAD result in an STL file.
usage: Use a visible STL caption; a shape alone cannot reliably communicate a file format.
